## About me

I am an evolutionary and computational biologist, currently Assistant Professor at the University of Trieste.

My work has been focused on:

- ancient DNA, particularly in the context of archaic hominins
- evolutionary modeling
- population genomics

## Currently working on: 

- Methods to quantify genetic resources and biodiversity
- Computational methods to link mutations and DNA repair mechanisms in the context of CRISPR
- Ancient DNA from different regions of the world

In case you are interested in any of these topics just drop me a line!

## Teaching

- "Evolutionary Biology" (6 CFU) for STB and STAN Bachelor students 
- "Computational Genomics" (6 CFU) for the Master in Functional Genomics.
